subject: toothbrush holder
title: What If You Never Cleaned Your Toothbrush Holder?

scenes.text: What if you never cleaned your toothbrush holder? Your toothbrush might be clean. Where it sleeps isn't.
In a 2011 NSF International study, 22 families swabbed everyday items all over their homes.
The toothbrush holder came third germiest, beaten only by the dish sponge and the kitchen sink.
About 27 percent of holders carried coliform bacteria, the family that includes E. coli and Salmonella.
And 64 percent had yeast and mold, fed by water dripping off wet brushes every single day.
It even out-germed the bathroom faucet handles and light switches. And it holds the thing you put in your mouth.
